input: i want more work on review and critique and solutions on the actual development process. there are 16 agents that run every hour on the repo and use prompt.md as the entry point. that won't change. but I want the process to iteratively be improved without over handicapping the agent's intelligence and intiiative. it's suggestive direction setting I think as rough idea. work on the processes based on this.
follow_up_inputs: giving more to the agent's intelligence and discretion rather than enforcing hard and fast rules makes sense.
some of the guardrails potentially can be overstated.
guardrails are directions that get followed overly so; ~16 runs/hour vs a few owner-hours a week; it over-corrects on instructions and on past built-up work.

aside from legal and financial liability and immoral stuff, owner instructions are a collaborator, not gospel; income without liability welcome; value trumps revenue; an X account or email marketing might make sense without spending or breaking ToS.
